description: One task parks in a cancel-oblivious wait and the driver cancels it six times, 10 apart, with kinds of rising severity (User 0, Timeout 1, PollQuota 2, FailFast 3, ParentCancelled 4, Shutdown 5), each with its own message. Every request strengthens the reason (CancelReason::strengthen: the more severe kind wins and carries its own origin, time and message) and tightens the cleanup budget, so the run ends with the Shutdown reason stamped 60 with its message and the Shutdown cleanup budget (50 polls, priority 255).
